jobDescription: ROLE OVERVIEW This Senior Program Manager will help build and scale a new B2C benefits business for 3L+ blue-collar associates on TeamLease payroll, driving awareness, adoption, engagement, and transactions for benefits like early wage access and other offerings. The role is end-to-end: from program design and launch to cross-functional execution, to commercial impact and revenue growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Plan, detail, schedule, and launch multiple initiatives to drive awareness, adoption, engagement, and repeat transactions for associate benefits on the app and other channels. • Work with product and tech teams to improve app experience and benefit discoverability, ensuring simple journeys that nudge associates to try and repeatedly use benefits. • Design and run ongoing engagement programs (calling/WhatsApp/SMS/field outreach, etc.) to regularly connect with associates, collect feedback, and identify new benefit opportunities. • Set up structured program plans, milestones, and dashboards to track initiative performance and funnel metrics (awareness → activation → repeat usage → revenue). • Continuously review execution, identify bottlenecks, and suggest modifications or course corrections to deliver target outcomes. • Align and coordinate with stakeholders across functions – product, technology, sales/field teams, HR operations, partners/vendors, marketing, finance – to ensure timely and high-quality execution. • Own program-level reporting, reviews, and communication with business leadership, highlighting key insights, risks, and improvement opportunities. • Drive direct impact on revenue growth through increased program adoption, transaction volumes, and monetization from partner benefits (e.g., commissions and transaction fees). MUST-HAVE SKILLS • Functional & Program Management ◦ Strong program management skills: ability to translate business goals into structured initiatives, detailed plans, and clear milestones. ◦ Proven capability in tracking execution rigorously and driving outcomes through structured reviews, metrics, and corrective actions. ◦ Comfort working in zero-to-one or early-stage business environments with ambiguity and evolving priorities. • Analytical & Data Orientation ◦ High comfort with data: ability to define success metrics, analyze dashboards/reports, and take data-backed decisions on what to scale, fix, or stop. ◦ Ability to run simple experiments (A/B tests, cohort analysis, communication tests) and convert insights into concrete program changes. • Stakeholder & Execution Leadership ◦ Strong stakeholder management: able to work with different types of people and functions and get things one without always having direct authority. ◦ Excellent communication and influencing skills, both written and verbal, to align cross-functional teams on priorities and timelines. ◦ High ownership mindset, bias for action, and comfort in rolling up sleeves to solve operational issues when needed. • Behavioural ◦ Smart problem solver with structured thinking and practical, street-smart execution orientation. ◦ Hustler mindset with strong initiative, resilience, and ability to navigate on-ground realities of a blue-collar associate base. GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS • Prior experience in B2C product or program roles (fintech, benefits, consumer apps, marketplaces, HRTech, or staffing/ecosystem businesses). • Experience working with blue-collar or mass-market customer segments in India, including understanding of their digital behavior and constraints. • Exposure to growth/engagement roles: user lifecycle management, CRM campaigns, and funnel optimization. • Experience collaborating with external partners/vendors and managing commercial or operational relationships. • Comfort using analytics/BI tools, marketing automation, and basic SQL/Excel for deeper analysis (preferred, not mandatory). WORK EXPERIENCE • 3–7 years of total experience in program management, business operations, product/growth, or strategy/consulting with strong execution exposure. • Demonstrated experience in: ◦ Launching and managing multi-stakeholder programs end-to-end. ◦ Driving measurable impact on revenue, usage, or customer engagement. ◦ Working in fast-paced or early-stage setups. EDUCATION • MBA from Tier 1/Tier 2 colleges is required.

jobDescription: Role Objective Drive awareness, adoption, enrollment and revenue generation for TeamLease’s B2C product portfolio by engaging with associates working across client organizations throughout India. The role is responsible for outbound sales, customer engagement, product pitching, objection handling and deal closure through telephonic interactions. Why This Role Matters TeamLease serves a large associate base across India. This role directly contributes to product adoption, customer engagement and revenue growth by helping associates discover and subscribe to relevant products and services. Key Responsibilities  Conduct high-volume outbound calls  Generate product awareness and drive customer engagement.  Generate referrals  Pitch low-ticket-size B2C products and services.  Close sales over phone calls and maximize conversion rates.  Cross-sell and upsell relevant products from the portfolio.  Handle objections related to pricing, fees, eligibility and value proposition.  Support app onboarding, registration and activation journeys.  Capture customer feedback and market insights. Key Result Areas (KRAs) Metric Expectation Outbound Calls High daily activity Meaningful Connections Customer engagement Sales Conversion Deal closure Revenue Achievement Target attainment Cross-Sell/Upsell Portfolio penetration Activation Rate Successful onboarding Must-Have Requirements  1 to 4 years of Inside Sales, Tele Sales or B2C Sales experience.  Proven track record of selling and closing deals over phone calls.  Experience in target-driven and incentive-led environments.  Strong verbal communication skills in Hindi & English along with proficiency in at least one regional language  Strong persuasion, objection handling and negotiation skills.  Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls daily. Preferred Backgrounds Personal Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, FinTech, EdTech, Telecom, Consumer Durables, Subscription Sales and Customer Acquisition roles. Language Advantage Candidates proficient in Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi will be strongly preferred. Multilingual candidates will have a significant advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for aggressive, ambitious and highly motivated sales professionals who thrive on incentives, recognition and performance-based rewards. Candidates who can build trust quickly, create urgency and close deals during customer conversations will be highly successful in this role. Success in This Role High Activity. High Conversion. High Earnings.

jobDescription: Role Overview: We are looking for a dynamic Inside Sales Specialist who will be responsible for new client acquisition and growth of existing accounts. The ideal candidate should be a go-getter with a proven track record in B2B inside sales, preferably within the staffing or services industry. This role requires strong relationship-building skills with decision-makers, proactive lead generation, and the ability to convert opportunities into revenue. Key Responsibilities:  Drive new client acquisition and manage growth accounts.  Identify and qualify leads through cold calling, referrals, and other outbound methods.  Build and nurture client relationships to expand the service portfolio.  Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets through pipeline management.  Own the sales cycle from lead generation to closure.  Develop and maintain relationships with CXO-level stakeholders.  Maintain deep market intelligence including competitor analysis and client behavior.  Work closely with internal teams (delivery, operations, etc.) to ensure client satisfaction and smooth onboarding.  Forecast and report sales metrics and performance to leadership. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):  Number of qualified leads generated per month  Volume and quality of outbound activities (calls/emails)  Sales pipeline health and proposal submissions per week  Revenue generated from new and existing accounts  Number of new accounts acquired  Client engagement and retention rates Qualifications & Experience:  Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred  2–3 years of experience in B2B inside sales, preferably in the staffing or recruitment industry  Proven success in high-pressure, target-driven environments  Strong ability to hunt and acquire new business accounts  Excellent communication and presentation skills  Comfortable interacting with senior decision-makers Skills Required:  Proficient in using CRM tools, Microsoft Office, and sales automation platforms  Strong negotiation and closing skills  Time management and multitasking ability  High energy, self-motivated, and team-oriented approach

jobDescription: Role: The Anchors of the Letters team is responsible for the timely generation of Offer letters of the Apprentices hired at various clients place Key Responsibilities: ● Apprentice Document collection to roll out Offer Letters as per SLA and maintain 100% statutory documents. (Aadhar, PAN, Education and all compliance documents ) ● Validating bank details as per timeline. ● Apprentice E-onboarding. ● Visiting client places for HELP DESK and INDUCTIONS and capable in handling the queries of apprentices and clients ● Follow up with apprentices/clients for document pendency ● Accuracy on document collecting from apprentices & clients and upload the same into Team Lease portal (ALCS & TLCS) Education & Experience ● Graduation in any Stream ● 1-2 years of Corporate experience ● Proficient in Microsoft Excel ● Ability to work under pressure and fast-paced environment

jobDescription: Role & Responsibilities: ● Payroll Processing: Execute end-to-end payroll processing tasks, including data entry, calculations, and ensuring accuracy in payroll transactions. Handle payroll for all Trainees / Apprentice, including salary, benefits, taxes, and deductions. ● Compliance and Regulation: Ensure compliance with company policies, as well as local, state, and federal regulations related to apprentice payroll. ● Problem Resolution: Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and issues promptly and accurately. Address Clients inquiries and concerns regarding payroll matters. ● Auditing and Reporting: Conduct regular audits of payroll records to ensure accuracy and compliance. Prepare payroll-related reports for management and other stakeholders as needed. Prepare Debit Note & Credit Note for short and excess billing as needed. Education & Experience ● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field. ● Proven experience in client onboarding or customer service roles. ● Strong organizational and multitasking skills. ● Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. ● Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. ● Proficiency in MS Office and other relevant software applications.

jobDescription: Position Overview: We are looking for an experienced Support Lead / Support Manager to drive application support operations, manage a team of support engineers, and ensure seamless delivery of support services for our HRTech products and platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise, excellent customer management skills, and proven experience in leading support teams. This role requires ownership of incident management, service delivery, stakeholder communication, process improvement, and continuous enhancement of customer experience while ensuring adherence to SLA commitments. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership & People Management ● Lead, mentor, and manage a team of L1, L2, and L3 Support Engineers. ● Drive team performance through regular reviews, coaching, and skill development initiatives. ● Plan team capacity, shift schedules, resource allocation, and workload balancing. ● Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer-centricity. ● Conduct performance evaluations and support career development planning. Service Delivery & Support Operations ● Ensure timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and escalations within agreed SLAs. ● Own end-to-end support delivery for HRTech applications and platforms. ● Monitor support metrics, ticket queues, response times, and resolution effectiveness. ● Manage critical incidents and coordinate cross-functional teams for rapid resolution. ● Establish and maintain support governance frameworks and operational excellence. Client & Stakeholder Management ● Act as the primary escalation point for key customers and internal stakeholders. ● Build strong relationships with customers by ensuring high-quality support experiences. ● Conduct regular service reviews and provide operational updates to stakeholders. ● Drive customer satisfaction through proactive communication and issue management. Technical & Platform Support ● Provide advanced troubleshooting support for application, database, and infrastructure- related issues. ● Analyze recurring incidents and implement permanent corrective actions. ● Support application deployments, upgrades, and production releases. ● Leverage SQL, cloud technologies, and monitoring tools to diagnose and resolve complex issues. ● Collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and QA teams to improve product stability. Process Improvement & Governance ● Drive adoption of ITIL-based support processes and best practices. ● Develop and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge repositories, and support documentation. ● Identify automation opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. ● Monitor service performance trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives. ● Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and security standards. Reporting & Analytics ● Track and report KPIs such as SLA adherence, MTTR, ticket backlog, customer satisfaction, and incident trends. ● Prepare management dashboards and executive summaries. ● Provide insights and recommendations to improve operational performance and customer experience. Qualifications: ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. ● 6+ years of experience in Application/Product Support, with at least 2+ years of team management experience. ● Strong experience managing support operations in a SaaS, HRTech, ERP, or enterprise application environment. ● Proven experience handling customer escalations and stakeholder management. ● Strong understanding of ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Management. ● Hands-on experience with SQL query writing, database troubleshooting, and log analysis. ● Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS. ● Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. ● Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

jobDescription: Position Overview: The main purpose of the L3 support engineer is establishing Support delivery for TeamLease and being the leader in delivering solutions using ITIL processes and philosophy. The successful candidate will be responsible for being able to maintain a very good client relationship and provide L3 support to them. Roles and Responsibilities: ● L3 Support ● Managing client relationship ● Managing on-boarding of new clients, setup ● Provide application end to end support which includes SQL and AWS skills. ● Deliver industry best practice solutions to the business using out of the box functionality. ● Provide first class solutions to meet the business expectations. ● Work with various teams in the IT Organisation in solutioning, planning, risk identification, issue resolution. ● Driving innovation/automated solutions ● Responsible for successful digital transformation delivery as per Teamlease Vision. ● Responsible for establishing industry specific best practices in establishing the ITIL processes. ● Responsible for Control development processes, platform and tools usage for solutions and delivery and enforce processes ● Strong experience and expertise in solution delivery and strategy in a bi-modal IT environment ● Broad knowledge of software development and software testing methodologies along with change and configuration management practices in various cloud environments ● Demonstrated expertise in bottleneck problems analysis Qualifications: ● Bachelor’s degree in B.E./ B.Tech/ CSE or a related computing field is required. ● 3 years of experience with L3 application support ● Strong skill in database SQL query writing. ● Experienced in all phases of the software development life-cycle (SDLC) with specific focus on ITIL process. ● Experience in SQL Server and writing scripts to support applications. ● Experience in linux and any scripting language is a plus ● AWS cloud experience (optional) ● Certification on ITIL is a plus. ● Experience in managing client relationships. ● Excellent in troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills

jobDescription: Role: The role would involve knowledge in processing offer letters and full & final settlements, as well as payroll inputs such as LOP, RLOP earnings & deductions, salary revisions, and gratuity. They should be able to handle 10-15 client IDs independently and have basic knowledge on PF/ESIC/PT/LWF. Additionally, they should be able to follow-up with clients for inputs, payments, and clarifications, close client queries within TAT, and have knowledge on all letter processes such as experience, relieving, warning, termination, and recovery letters. Key Responsibilities: ● Should have knowledge in Processing offer letters ● Should have knowledge in Processing Full & Final settlement ● Follow-up with the client for inputs, Payments & any other clarifications ● Should have complete knowledge in Processing Payroll inputs like, LOP, RLOP Earnings & Deductions, Salary revisions, Gratuity etc. and must be able to handle independently with 10-15 client-IDs ● Basic Knowledge on PF/ESIC/PT/LWF. ● Able to close client queries with in TAT ● Should have knowledge on all letters process like experience, relieving, Warning, Termination & Recovery letters Education & Experience: ● Experience in payroll domain for executive and for fresher Basic Knowledge on payroll. ● Graduates in any stream. ● Good Communication Skills ● Knowledge of MS office- Excel, Word & PowerPoint presentation ● Gmail & Google Sheet knowledge mandatory ● Good analytical and problem solving skills with ability to meet applicable deadlines

jobDescription: Role: Sales Manager shall own and oversee activities of the new client acquisition. Should be able to build and maintain relationships with decision makers in clients resulting in new acquisitions. Grow business by achieving revenue targets with new clients by means of new service offerings. Become a trusted service partner by meeting the client needs and exceeding client expectations. This role requires you to visit the TeamLease office once a day, and have at least 2 physical meetings in a day with prospective customers. Key Responsibilities: Responsible for new client acquisition. Responsible for meeting Business goals on the new Headcount acquisition and Revenue Prospecting through cold calling and other channels Create healthy pipeline Ability to hunt for new and large accounts Demonstrate strong ability to manage multiple Sales opportunities simultaneously Forecasting monthly & quarterly sales targets and executing them in a given time frame. Analyzing latest marketing trends(including competition) Develop high level relationships with CXO’s Demonstrate ability to manage internal stakeholders to meet client expectation at a regular basis

jobDescription: Role: Sales Manager shall own and oversee activities of the new client acquisition. Should be able to build and maintain relationships with decision makers in clients resulting in new acquisitions. Grow business by achieving revenue targets with new clients by means of new service offerings. Become a trusted service partner by meeting the client needs and exceeding client expectations. This role requires you to visit the TeamLease office once a day, and have at least 2 physical meetings in a day with prospective customers. Key Responsibilities: Responsible for new client acquisition. Responsible for meeting Business goals on the new Headcount acquisition and Revenue Prospecting through cold calling and other channels Create healthy pipeline Ability to hunt for new and large accounts Demonstrate strong ability to manage multiple Sales opportunities simultaneously Forecasting monthly & quarterly sales targets and executing them in a given time frame. Analyzing latest marketing trends(including competition) Develop high level relationships with CXO’s Demonstrate ability to manage internal stakeholders to meet client expectation at a regular basis Education: ● MBA from Premium B-School (preferred) ● Experience: o Min. 3 years of exp. in Corporate Sales o Exposed to an aggressive and highly competitive sales environment. ● High on learn-ability.

jobDescription: Role: Sales Manager shall own and oversee activities of the new client acquisition. Should be able to build and maintain relationships with decision makers in clients resulting in new acquisitions. Grow business by achieving revenue targets with new clients by means of new service offerings. Become a trusted service partner by meeting the client needs and exceeding client expectations. This role requires you to visit the TeamLease office once a day, and have at least 2 physical meetings in a day with prospective customers. Key Responsibilities: ● Responsible for new client acquisition. ● Responsible for meeting Business goals on the new Headcount acquisition and Revenue Prospecting through cold calling and other channels ● Create healthy pipeline ● Ability to hunt for new and large accounts ● Demonstrate strong ability to manage multiple Sales opportunities simultaneously ● Forecasting monthly & quarterly sales targets and executing them in a given time frame. ● Analyzing latest marketing trends(including competition) ● Develop high level relationships with CXO’s ● Demonstrate ability to manage internal stakeholders to meet client expectation at a regular basis Education & Experience ● MBA from Premium B-School (preferred) ● Min. 3 years of exp. in Corporate Sales

jobDescription: Role: The Outbound Marketing Specialist will be responsible for planning and executing targeted outreach programs to create engagement and generate qualified opportunities for the enterprise business. The role focuses on Account-Based Marketing (ABM) on LinkedIn, multi-channel outreach, and high-quality communication to engage decision-makers in priority accounts. Key Responsibilities: ● Conduct prospect and account research to identify stakeholders, personalise outreach, and refine target account lists (prospecting the suspects). ● Research on target companies and buyer personas, monitoring news, triggers, and developments to perform timely outreach. ● Plan and execute ABM campaigns on emails and LinkedIn for defined target accounts and buyer personas to drive meetings and nurture interest. ● Run multi-channel outreach (email, call, LinkedIn) to drive event invitations, follow-ups, and engagement for physical events, webinars, podcasts and campaigns. ● Collaborate with content/marketing teams to adapt case studies, decks, and event assets for outbound use (email copy, LinkedIn messages, call scripts). ● Work closely with business development teams to align outreach messaging, targeting, and follow-up processes. ● Track outreach performance, maintain accurate records in the CRM, and recommend improvements based on data. Required experience and skills: ● 2–4 years of experience in outbound marketing or demand generation in a B2B environment. ● Solid understanding of ABM, outbound funnels, and prospecting best practices. ● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write concise, personalised outreach messages. ● Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, email outreach tools, and CRM platforms.

jobDescription: About TeamLease (https://group.teamlease.com) TeamLease Services is one of India’s leading people supply chain companies offering a range of solutions to 3900+ employers for their hiring, productivity, and scale challenges. Listed on the NSE & BSE, TeamLease has hired 23 lakh+ people over the last 24 years. The company offers solutions to large, medium, and small clients across the 3Es of Employment (around 3.5 lakh associates/trainees), Employability (over 7 lakh students), and E-workforce (over 1000 employers). In FY2015, TeamLease rolled out DA (Degree Apprenticeship) to provide on-the-job training to apprentices. About TeamLease HRTech (https://www.teamleasehrtech.com/) TeamLease HRTech is a trusted partner providing a comprehensive suite of HR solutions, including a cutting-edge SaaS HRMS platform, managed payroll outsourcing, and specialized permanent hiring services. With over 6.5 lakh employee records managed seamlessly across 600+ customers, we empower organizations through deep industry understanding, decades of HR expertise, and streamlined implementation processes. Our proven payroll capabilities ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence. At TeamLease HRTech, we leverage our extensive experience to simplify HR management, enabling businesses to focus on their core objectives and drive sustainable growth. Top brands across India choose TeamLease HRTech for tailored solutions, unmatched expertise, and effortless HR transformation About the role Role Title: Manager Business: HR Tech Sub-Department/Function: Sales-HCM Location: Bengaluru Reporting to: Sales Head Role: Sales Manager shall own and oversee activities of the new client acquisition. Should be able to build and maintain relationships with decision makers in clients resulting in new acquisitions. Grow business by achieving revenue targets with new clients by means of new service offerings. Become a trusted service partner by meeting the client needs and exceeding client expectations. This role requires you to visit the TeamLease office once a day, and have at least 2 physical meetings in a day with prospective customers. Key Responsibilities: ● Drive revenue numbers from existing/new clients for HRtech SaaS, Platform Sales. ● Aggressively expand customer base by identifying avenues for generating revenue through extensive networking with CHRO’s/ HR Heads. ● Building a strong sales pipeline of potential clients through various channels, conversion to prospects. ● Managing perspective client relationships through all phases of the sales cycle ● Hand Holding the clients for standard sign-up, migration process for SaaS, platform sales. ● Working with a client solutions team for drafting value propositions based on inputs and coordinating with key stakeholders. ● Handles escalations with Clients to ensure continuous revenue from clients and retention of billing from clients. ● Lead in-person client presentations to C-level executives, including information discovery sessions, product demonstrations and proposals ● Ownership on collections, bad debts, process related activities like offers, recons, etc. ● Participation in various HRtech forums, seminars to increase prospect base and build robust sales pipeline to achieve revenue numbers. ● Collaborate with internal product teams and provide feedback from the field to help shape future product development Education & Experience: ● MBA from Premium B-School (preferred) ● Experience: o Min. 4- years of exp. in Corporate Sales in HR Service Industry o Exposed to an aggressive and highly competitive sales environment. ● High on learn-ability.
